Only 22% of remote job listings on Loker Dollar disclose a pay figure. The other 78% just say "DOE" — determined on experience — leaving you to guess the USD salary your skills are worth.

Our data from 4,280 active remote listings:
- 940 (22%) state a concrete USD figure
- 3,340 (78%) leave pay blank, signaling DOE
- 2,735 (64%) accept applicants from any country
- 1,213 were posted in the last 7 days

A hidden number isn't always a red flag. DOE can be a negotiation lever: rare skills like AI or data analysis let you aim for the top of the market band, and companies may hold flexible budgets they don't advertise. One listing in our sample, Online Consumer Panels America, shows $25–$45/hour.

How to negotiate a DOE wage: research global benchmarks, quantify your impact with metrics, anchor with a high-end range, and ask about total compensation.

Browse the latest DOE roles and start the conversation: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/what-is-doe-wage
